method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 in substance; a seat-neutral core (ada-core.l4) with four regulative rules (the complainant's steps with time limits) run by EVALTRACE inside functions that take only plain facts; one seat layer (the person with the complaint) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, dates or amounts, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Anti-Discrimination Act 1977 No 48 (NSW), corpus document nsw_legislation:2024-07-01/act-1977-048 from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (collected 10 March 2025; unofficial, possibly out of date), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1977-048.txt (text sha256 c16a7666702e360fcdc771f0a4ad159540a55d97ff6395e9147c0ecad2a11c18). No regulation sets a number the encoded sections use.

seat: the person with the complaint: the job applicant, employee, contractor or other worker discriminated against, sexually harassed, victimised or retired because of age, who complains to the President and may go on to the Tribunal (ada-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ada-dates.l4 ; l4 run ada-core.l4 ; l4 run ada-seat.l4 ; l4 run ada-cases.l4
checks.result: 186 assertions written, 186 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-08); a negative control (the small-employer exclusion from 5 to 6, the complaint period from 12 to 13 months, in a scratch copy) failed 7 assertions (8 predicted; the eighth prediction was wrong, see NOTES.md)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: s 4 definitions used; s 4A; the meaning of discrimination on all eight grounds (ss 7, 24, 38A, 38B, 39, 49A, 49B, 49S, 49T, 49ZF, 49ZG, 49ZYA); discrimination against applicants and employees (ss 8, 25, 38C, 40, 49D, 49V, 49ZH, 49ZYB) with their exclusions; the exceptions reaching them (ss 14, 15, 16, 21, 31, 35, 36, 38Q, 46, 49, 49D(4), 49P, 49PA, 49Q, 49V(4), 49ZYI, 49ZYJ, 49ZYK, 49ZYR, 49ZYS, 54, 56); ss 22A, 22B(1)-(7); Part 4E (ss 49ZU, 49ZV, 49ZX, 49ZW); ss 50, 53; Part 9 ss 87A, 87C, 89B(2)(b), 91A(5)-(9), 92C, 93A, 93B, 94B, 96(1), 108(2)(a), (4), (5), (7), 111A, 112. Out: Division 3 of each Part (other areas), the other work relationships (commission agents, contract workers, partnerships, councillors, industrial organisations, qualifying bodies, employment agencies), vilification, ss 22B(8), 22C-22J, 51, 52, exceptions that do not reach work, the President's and Tribunal's procedure that gives the complainant no step, and the machinery. Reasons in NOTES.md.
